notes: 21 Jump Street has authoritative FAST distribution evidence from FilmRise/Shout, Tubi, Samsung, and Rakuten, and its candidate uses a Wurl host.
The existing production playback resolver returned HTTP 404 for the 21 Jump Street candidate, so it was not marked playable or merged.
Dinos 24/7 and Forensic Files alternatives resolve through jmp2.uk and were rejected before media validation.
KIRO Seattle uses CloudFront and Most Haunted uses an Amagi Rakuten UK playout host, but exact lawful source-to-canonical provenance remains to be established before full testing.
